name: Democratic Party
description: Follow Democratic Party, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Voters are fed up with data centers. Both parties are trying to cash in for midterms
changes.summary: Democrats and Republicans have found common ground in this campaign season. Both parties have poured millions into ads attacking data centers as the public continues to protest the AI facilities. (Image credit: Thomas Simonetti).

changes.title: Gallup Polls Show Democrats Outnumber Republicans Ahead of 2026 Midterm Elections
changes.summary: Data from Gallup shows that Democrats and Democratic-leaning independents have their largest advantage over Republicans since 2008.

changes.title: Trump's first major midterm money move: A $10 million Texas Senate ad blitz
changes.summary: This is the first significant spending in a premier general election contest by MAGA, Inc., and reflects how a once-safe Republican seat in Texas may be viable for Democrats with the candidacy of James Talarico.

changes.title: Ossoff and Talarico to Share Fund-Raising Event in Hollywood
changes.summary: The event with the Georgia and Texas Democrats will be hosted by Shonda Rhimes.

changes.title: Brooks and Capehart on Trump calling Iran war 'small potatoes'
changes.summary: David Brooks of The Atlantic and Jonathan Capehart of MS NOW join Geoff Bennett to discuss the week in politics, including President Trump's remarks calling the conflict with Iran "small potatoes," the president's influence over the midterm elections, how Democrats are campaigning and Sen. changes.title: Pentagon Agreement With N.I.H. on Biodefense Draws Alarm From Democrats
changes.summary: Under a new partnership, the Defense Department would play a larger role in biodefense and pandemic preparedness. Democrats warned it could allow a Pentagon cash grab.

changes.title: Missouri Supreme Court pauses GOP gerrymander, likely netting Democrats 1 House seat
changes.summary: Missouri’s Supreme Court suspended a congressional map that state Republicans drew last year that would have netted the GOP an additional House seat, likely keeping the seat in Democratic hands this November. The court ruled unanimously on Thursday that a referendum petition organized by Democrats to put the new congre.

changes.title: Voters are "pissed about the economy," former Obama aide analyzes midterms
changes.summary: Most midterm primaries have already passed, yielding data and trends that inform how general elections could go. Former Obama aide Ravi Gupta joins CBS News with more on how Democrats and Republicans are performing in the 2026 midterms so far.

changes.title: Stephen A. Smith has some words for Democrats as he makes his 2028 plans clear
changes.summary: Sports broadcaster Stephen A. Smith has been bouncing around cable TV but insists he’s staying out of one arena: the political one. The outspoken ESPN and SiriusXM personality isn’t staying away from talking politics — far from it. But Smith told POLITICO in an interview airing Thursday that he’s not running for presid.

changes.title: As Midterms Loom, Democrats Feud Over Defections
changes.summary: The fight has highlighted party divisions and raised questions about how Democrats will run the House should they win the majority.
